lines.say: Stop deleting your AI chats every time your roommate borrows your phone.
Lock that chat instead, like a locker inside your cupboard.
lines.show: Lock one chat, like a locker.

lines.say: Set a four digit PIN in settings, then lock it.
The cupboard opens, the locker doesn't. Free users get it too.
lines.show: Cupboard opens. Locker doesn't. Free too.

lines.say: The catch: it's rolling out slowly. Your app may not have it.
lines.show: The catch: it's rolling out slowly.

lines.say: Forgetting the PIN deletes nothing. Resetting it deletes every locked chat, forever.
lines.show: Forgetting is fine. Resetting deletes them all.

lines.say: Send this to the friend who always borrows your phone. Type PRIVATE below.
lines.show: Send this. Comment PRIVATE for the card.
